description.zh: 批准补丁是否包括除安全性之外的更新
description.en: Specifies whether the approved patch involves updates other than security-related updates.
The number of entries returned per page.
The name of the patch baseline.
The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results.

description.zh:
操作系统类型。支持：
- AliyunLinux
- Windows
- Ubuntu
- Centos
- Debian
- RedhatEnterpriseLinux
- Anolis
description.en:
The type of the operating system. Valid values:

*   Windows
*   Ubuntu
*   CentOS
*   Debian
*   AliyunLinux
*   RedhatEnterpriseLinux
*   Anolis
*   AlmaLinux
The ID of the resource group.

The share type of the template. Valid values:

*   **Public**
*   **Private**

example.unifiedCli: aliyun oos list-patch-baselines --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --name MyPatchBaseline --operation-system AliyunLinux --share-type Private --max-results 50 --next-token - --tags Value=value Key=key --approved-patches ApprovedPatch1 --approved-patches-enable-non-security true --sources main_name=MyCustomRepository_baseurl=https://my-custom-repository_enabled=1 --resource-group-id rg-acfmxsn4m4000000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun oos ListPatchBaselines --region cn-hangzhou --ApprovedPatches '["ApprovedPatch1"]' --NextToken '-' --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmxsn4m4000000' --MaxResults 50 --ApprovedPatchesEnableNonSecurity true --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --OperationSystem AliyunLinux --Sources '["main_name=MyCustomRepository_baseurl=https://my-custom-repository_enabled=1"]' --Tags '[{"Value":"value","Key":"key"}]' --Name MyPatchBaseline --ShareType Private
